How Does Online Puja & Havan Booking Work?

Wherever you are in India or abroad, your personal Sankalp with Name & Gotra is performed in 4 simple steps:

1

Submit Name & Gotra

Enter the devotee's name, father/husband's name, Gotra, and specific problem details via the online form or WhatsApp.

Based on the Vedic Panchang, an auspicious Nakshatra and date are selected and dedicated Nalkheda Vedic scholars are appointed.

Live Video Call Sankalp

Connect live via WhatsApp video call. Pandit Ji recites your Name & Gotra before the blazing sacred altar during Purnahuti.

Prasad & Bhasma Delivery

Devotee Clarifications

Frequently Asked Questions (Online Puja)

Authoritative answers to common questions asked by devotees regarding online rituals and havan.

help

Does an online Sankalp give the same spiritual benefits as physical presence?

Yes, in Sanatan Vedic tradition, the sacred utterance of the devotee's 'Name' and 'Gotra' establishes an immediate direct spiritual connection with Agni Dev and the presiding deity. Since ancient Treta and Dvapara yugas, rulers and householders appointed authorized Vedic priests for representative Sankalps. Performed at the self-manifested shrine of Nalkheda Dham, the ritual yields full scriptural fruits.

help

Do I need to fast or follow special dietary rules on the day of the havan?

On the day the havan is performed in your name, avoid tamasic foods (meat, alcohol, onion, garlic). Strict fasting is not mandatory, but maintaining satvik conduct, mentally chanting Maa Baglamukhi's mantra, and wearing yellow clothing multiplies the divine vibrations.

help

In how many days does the consecrated Prasad reach my address?

On the next working day following puja completion, the sacred Raksha Sutra, Mata's Prasad, and energized Bhojpatra Yantra are securely packed and dispatched via India Post Speed Post. Across India, parcels typically arrive within 4 to 6 business days. Tracking numbers are shared directly on WhatsApp.

help

Will my personal crisis and information remain confidential?

Rest assured. It is the strict scriptural discipline of Tantra Peeth Nalkheda that every devotee's name, family situation, litigation details, or enemy disputes remain exclusively between the devotee and Pandit Ji. Your information is never disclosed on any public platform.
